run_fb15k_training: run the FB15k knowledge graph embedding training example with a custom config file
run_fb15k_eval: run the FB15k evaluation with filtered or unfiltered ranking on the test set
download_and_extract_fb15k: download and extract the FB15k dataset from the FBAI public files URL
convert_tsv_edgelist: convert raw TSV edge list files into the binary format for PyTorch BigGraph training
load_fb15k_config: load a PyTorch BigGraph config file with optional parameter overrides for FB15k
